answer: Epoch-pattern continuity gate. Each identity must keep a coherent action-timing and cohort-overlap profile across at least three epochs; deviations trigger quarantine. A glacier-slow probation blocks new identities from high-weight actions until that profile stabilizes. Every sybil thus pays separate runtime, latency, and failed-check costs rather than sharing one history. Reused behavior is rejected as a fable copied across accounts. Any cloned old relic trace is flagged and the identity discarded. The attacker cannot amortize one history across many identities.
